title: Reinforcement Learning
standfirst: Learning by trial and error — MDPs, value and policy methods, and modern deep RL.

description_paragraphs: This course enables students to understand the reinforcement learning paradigm, identify suitable problem settings for RL, and implement and evaluate core RL algorithms. This course is also offered as an elective for PG-diploma students.
faculty: Prof. Balaraman Ravindran, Wadhwani School of Data Science, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Introduction to reinforcement learning; Bandits and exploration-exploitation; TD learning (Tic-tac-toe); Regret and PAC frameworks; UCB and contextual bandits.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Full RL problem formulation; Markov Decision Processes (MDPs); Returns and value functions; Illustrative MDP examples.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Bellman equations; Optimality equations; Dynamic programming (policy evaluation and improvement).

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Value iteration; Dynamic programming extensions; Monte Carlo methods; DP vs MC vs TD comparison.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Temporal Difference (TD) learning; SARSA and Q-learning; On-policy vs off-policy learning.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: N-step methods and TD(λ); Double Q-learning.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Function approximation; State and action representations; Deep Q-Networks (DQN); Advanced value-based methods.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Policy gradient methods; REINFORCE algorithm; Policy gradient theorem.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Policy Gradients: Introduction, Motivation, REINFORCE, PG theorem, Introduction to AC methods

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Monte Carlo policy gradients; Actor-critic methods; Deterministic policy gradients (DPG, DDPG).

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Hierarchical reinforcement learning; Options framework; Semi-Markov decision processes; Learning with temporally extended actions.
